purpose: Define a canonical Memory Record as explicit data with stable identity, content, provenance, scope, lifecycle metadata and optional semantic relations.

topics.name: Memory Record
topics.purpose: Define a canonical Memory Record as explicit data with stable identity, content, provenance, scope, lifecycle metadata and optional semantic relations.

semantics.identity_rule: Memory record identity is explicit and stable.
semantics.provenance_rule: Record identifies source/context/authoring operation where applicable.
semantics.relation_rule: Links to users, Projects, Topics, Domains or other records are explicit relations.
semantics.mutation_rule: Changing machine-significant memory content is an explicit update/versioned write, never silent in-place model mutation.
semantics.semantic_similarity_rule: Similarity may retrieve candidate memories but never defines canonical identity.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant memory is explicit addressable provenance-bearing data; retrieval and storage never create hidden authority or implicit execution.

hard_gates.condition: memory identity inferred only from semantic similarity
relation inferred from natural-language text only
